div.head: I Ew 1.5
div.ab: Eac we cwædon; gif enig yfelra manna wære ðe wolde oðres yrfe to borge settan for wiðertihtlan, ðæt he gecyþe ðonne mid aðe, ðæt he hit for nanum facne ne dyde, ac mid [folcrihte] butan brede ⁊ bigswice; ⁊ se dyde þonne swa ðer he dorste, ðe hit man ætfenge: swa he hit agnode, swa he hit tymde.

We have further declared, that if there is any evil man who by way of a countercharge wishes to place another's livestock under distraint, he shall swear an oath that he does it for no wicked end, but in accordance with public law and without fraud and guile; and in that case, he in whose possession the stock has been attached, shall adopt whichever he dares to [of the following two courses]: either he shall substantiate his title to it, or he shall vouch it to warranty.

Eac we cwædan; gif hwa gemearra manna wære ðe wolde oðres yrfe to borge seatan for wiðertihtlan, þæt he gecyðe ðonne mid aðe, ðæt he hit for nanum facne ne dyde, ac mid folcrihte butan bræde ⁊ biswice; ⁊ se dyde ðonne swa ðer he dorste, ðe hit man ætfence: swa he hit ahnode, swa he hit tymæde.
